entries.heading: Section 5303(r)(2)(C) of title 49, United States Code, is
ancestors: DIVISION K—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2017
entries.text:
Sec. 192.  Section 5303(r)(2)(C) of title 49, United States Code, is 
amended--
            (1) by inserting ``and 25 square miles of land area'' after 
        ``145,000''; and
            (2) by inserting ``and 12 square miles of land area'' after 
        ``65,000''.

    This title may be cited as the ``Department of Transportation 
Appropriations Act, 2017''.
